articles.summary:

articles.title: Microsoft Warns Hackers Are Exploiting Microsoft 365 Outages to Launch Credential Phishing Attacks
articles.summary:

articles.title: GitLab Patches 37 Security Vulnerabilities Affecting CI/CD Pipelines, GitLab Pages, and MCP Server
articles.summary:
GitLab released versions 19.5.6, 19.4.8, and 19.3.9 on November 16, 2026. These updates address 37 security vulnerabilities across both the Community Edition and the Enterprise Edition. The fixes include four high-severity issues, 24 medium-severity issues, and nine low-severity issues that affect development infrastructure, integrations, and AI features. articles.summary:

articles.title: Mozilla Releases Firefox 160 Security Update Fixing 99 Vulnerabilities, Including Sandbox Escape Flaws
articles.summary:
Mozilla has released Firefox 160 with fixes for 99 security vulnerabilities. Mozilla announced the update on November 10, 2026, as part of Mozilla Foundation Security Advisory 2026-125, which rates its overall impact as high. The advisory lists 57 high-severity flaws, 24 moderate and 18 low. Most of the high-severity bugs are memory-safety problems. Use-after-free errors […]

articles.summary:

articles.title: Apple Tightens macOS 27.3 Security to Stop Apps From Accessing Sensitive Files Without Explicit Permission
articles.summary:

Announced on November 16, 2026, these changes aim to increase transparency around powerful permissions while preserving the approvals users have already granted. Apple Tightens macOS 27.3 […]

articles.title: Old Bitly Links Hijacked to Redirect Users From McDonald’s, Burger King, and Government X Posts
articles.summary:
Old Bitly links embedded in historical X posts from McDonald’s, Burger King, government agencies, and prominent politicians have been repurposed to redirect visitors to unrelated websites. This incident highlights how trusted social media archives can become channels for redirection years after the original posts were published. This occurs even when the original messages remain unchanged, […]
